title: KMD carries public, pensions and insurance verticals but no researched stack behind its do-not-pitch tier
content:
KMD's row lists public sector, pensions and insurance as verticals and records its stack as not researched. The tier came from a mechanical rescore of a provisional v2 tail entry on size and slot occupancy, never from a v3 evidence pass.

Slot occupancy cannot be computed against an empty platform field, so size is the only input that could have produced the do-not-pitch placement. That is a legitimate screen for a Danish firm of KMD's standing, but it is a statement about scale rather than about fit, and the verticals on the row point the other way.

The flag closes with the same instruction as its neighbours: run the OSS-portfolio screen before acting. Until that happens the exclusion and the vertical attractiveness sit side by side on the row without either being resolved.

description: With no platform evidence recorded, size is the only input that could have produced the tier; the OSS-portfolio screen the flag asks for has still not been run.
